rules.name: Food
rules.intent: Updates about a food delivery order: confirmations, on-the-way notices and delivery receipts
rules.exceptions: it is a promotion or discount offer

rules.name: Receipts
rules.intent: Invoices, bills and payment receipts for things that are not food delivery

rules.name: Newsletters
rules.intent: Newsletters, digests and marketing or promotional mail sent to a list
rules.exceptions: it is a receipt or an order update

rules.name: Recruiters
rules.intent: A recruiter or hiring manager reaching out about a job opening
rules.exceptions: I have replied to this sender before

rules.name: Security codes
rules.intent: One-time passwords, sign-in codes and login alerts
